"""Compare search variants on structured/adversarial families (dev only)."""
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import bnb, planhard
from planstress import brute


class F:
    __slots__ = ('id', 'path', 'N')
    def __init__(self, i, p):
        self.id = 'f%d' % i; self.path = tuple(p); self.N = len(p)


def main():
    kinds = sys.argv[1].split(',')
    n = int(sys.argv[2]); iters = int(sys.argv[3])
    verify = len(sys.argv) > 4 and sys.argv[4] == 'verify'
    rng = random.Random(12345)
    for kind in kinds:
        tm = tn = 0.0; worst = (0, 0)
        for it in range(iters):
            req, bens = planhard.gen_hard(rng, n, kind)
            flows = [F(i, f['path']) for i, f in enumerate(req['flows'])]
            data, base, pre = bnb.prepare(flows, req['capacities'], bens, [])
            if data is None:
                continue
            b, usage, K, nn2, r0, order = data
            t0 = time.time(); vm, sm, _ = bnb.search_memo(b, usage, K, nn2, r0, order); tm += time.time()-t0
            t0 = time.time(); vb, sb, st = bnb.search_bnb(b, usage, K, nn2, r0, order); tn += time.time()-t0
            if time.time()-t0 > worst[0]: worst = (time.time()-t0, st['nodes'])
            if vm != vb:
                print('MISMATCH', kind, it, vm, vb, json.dumps(req)[:400])
            if verify:
                exp = brute(req['flows'], req['capacities'], bens, [])
                got = base + vb // (nn2 + 1)
                if exp is not None and got != exp[0]:
                    print('BRUTE MISMATCH', kind, it, got, exp, json.dumps(req)[:400])
        print('%-14s n=%d iters=%d memo=%.2fs bnb=%.2fs worstbnb=%.3fs/%dnodes' %
              (kind, n, iters, tm, tn, worst[0], worst[1]))


main()
PYEOF
